name: mcp-security-review
description: Security for AI coding: pre-coding threat review, dependency checks, code review checklists, threat models, and an opt-in runtime guard (asc-guard) for agent tool calls.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key (optional)
typesafe_api_key.description: Turns on the asc-guard runtime guard. Commands, file paths and tool output are then sent to TypeSafe for judgment. Leave empty to keep the guard off.
